name: page-edge
provenance: Authored by hand by the Test Developer (claude-opus-5) for MT-007 RED on 2026-09-15. Wholly synthetic.
purpose: AC-4. Two blobs hard against the page boundary - one at the top-left corner, one at the bottom-right - each inside a box that reaches the page edge, so dilation has nowhere to go and every polygon vertex must still land inside the page.
notes: TL = 60x50 = 3000 px, BR = 40x40 = 1600 px. Each box equals its blob, so each mask is pixel-exact at any dilation.
Emission order by (bbox y0, bbox x0) is TL then BR.
The legal polygon coordinate range is 0..319 in x and 0..239 in y: a polygon written in exclusive-end coordinates puts a vertex at x=320 and fails AC-4.
